Uniform Taylor control, a bounded-variation Fourier tail and a strict first-even-mode maximum yield both halves of the n^2 odd-order threshold limit. The 4,377 script checks test algebra, not infinity.

The theorem establishes nontrivial stability of the critical Gaussian-kernel negative-type exponent under that perturbation, sharp parity, and an exact coupled Fourier criterion for every finite graph.
